scope: PROBoost-reimplementation and corrected Chen Stacking as in source final branch. IPCW only. No changed hyperparameter, training budget, model algorithm, support threshold, selection policy, forecast cohort or original main pointer. New experiment; retrospective exposed cohorts.
design: 3 historical January 1 cutoffs (2023,2024,2025) x H12/H24 x 50 nonstratified company bootstraps x both algorithms = 600 requested model runs. Resample N original training companies with replacement from all N including early-censored; each company's multiplicity applies to all of its records. One original row per company here. Common year & repetition draw is paired across algorithms and horizons. No conditional resampling for rare events. Never discard a scheduled replicate.
randomization: repetition r=1..50 (all); numpy PCG64 with SeedSequence([20261104, year, r]), draw rng.integers(0,N,size=N). Materialize copies sorted by original row, no variation from arbitrary resampled row ordering. Preserve baseline algorithm RNG (including PROBoost seed 811, and subset-derived seeds for CV, IPSO, Hyperopt, GA, learners and SMOTE).
grouping: Convert unique-company StratifiedKFold partitions back to all copies, keeping all copies together at every nested level. Keep original seed(ix,salt) based on expanded ordered row indices. All preprocessing, IG, fits, LR, IPCW KM and OOF validation losses use multiplicities. Minimum true-positive company counts, fold counts and availability of distinct neighbours use distinct companies. Apply original SMOTE routine on one representative per distinct known in-fold company and append only its synthetic tail to expanded observations; at most one augmented point/distinct positive, no self-copy neighbours. Unit-multiplicity must reduce to original splits, search and augmentation. Dynamic fallback stays unchanged.
support: If <2 distinct known positives or <2 distinct known negatives prevent full required stratified outer CV, record unsupported for that model/cell without changing seed or retrying. Record any further training/numeric failure, no imputation or success-only denominator; separate technical retries for unchanged identity. Do not use a proxy classifier.
internal: Primary internal validation for both methods is prediction of original historical companies omitted from this bootstrap (OOB), by the complete selected/refit pipeline. No OOB inputs to tuning or fit. Use per-horizon IPCW estimated solely on the expanded in-bag sample; recovered treated as known negative, early-censored receive no supervised outcome weight; unknown never assigned true negative. Report OOB AUC, AP, checked count ceil(.2*N_oob), observed captured/known events, IPCW estimated coverage/precision/lift, unknown totals, distinct scores and score range on all OOB firms. Also log winner's tuning-CV AP (PROBoost), final deployment plan GA validation F1 where defined plus base fold F1 for Chen; those are not comparable to OOB final pipeline metrics.
external: Reuse source's original companies, ids, known labels, individual calendar horizons, annual ceil(.2*n) quotas with frozen deterministic ties; same-year weighted AUC, across-year pooled AUC/AP recomputed, Top20 captures/coverage/precision/lift. Exact unique score count, minimum, maximum and span on original score scale. 2025H24: train and predict including OOB internal analysis; external metrics & gap NA; retain score dispersion. No test-company bootstrap in this experiment.
gap: For each supported annual and pooled replicate report OOB-minus-test AUC/AP/coverage/precision/lift; rates in probability units. OOB rates use training-G weights; external endpoints are fully known and unit-weighted. Report raw counts separately (different OOB and test sample sizes). No outer-test data for any validation/tuning. OOB-minus-test measures distribution/time differences as well as optimism.
pool: Pool same replicate ID across independently sampled annual training snapshots. H12 includes all 3 years, H24 metrics include 2023/24 only, no replacement for an undefined annual fit. With a missing required fit, pooled forecast/metrics are NA (no omission of a year). Pooled OOB treats year-specific historical predictions as distinct cutoff-company assessments and preserves annual Top20 quotas, even if same historical company belongs to multiple snapshots; no independent-sample claim. Annual OOB with no known events has undefined AUC/AP; pooled OOB may be estimable on all contributing records.
distribution: All 50 predeclared repetitions shown with status; finite number & undefined count per metric. Linear quantiles .05,.50,.95, actual min/max. Original single baseline test score and its empirical midrank percentile 100*(less+0.5*equal)/n (numeric ties tolerance 1e-12); singleton OOB has no equivalent bootstrap-free original, report NA. Empirical ranges of training perturbations; no significance test or confidence-interval claim.
comparison: Show XAI-RSF fixed 120 overlapping 3-of-10 seed-triple models from archived original forests, same year/endpoints and pooled metrics, no XAI-RSF fit. Reference C039 explicitly postselected on exposed predictions; original 42/101/202 sensitivity shown. Distinguish training-data resampling from forest algorithm randomness at fixed data; no direct statistical comparison of widths.
privacy: Private ids, draws, OOB/outer individual scores, models and logs stay off Git. Publish aggregate metrics per repetition, summaries, method/verification, execution receipt and test log. All original data, models and pointers remain unchanged.
